main_conclusion_zh: 当前ACTIVE证实了优先重放已激活，却没有证实学习价值：1k更少零分但总分更低。下一步应把真实进度、遗忘admission和候选信用支持拆开验证；不再把rawA方差当最终收益。

papers.title: PAC: Progress-Augmented Advantage Curriculum for Multi-Task Reinforcement Learning of LLMs
papers.verified_method_zh: 任务级窗口平均|标准化优势|估更新潜力，另由近期平均reward拟合趋势；两者融合后做Gaussian Thompson选择，后验按样本证据量更新并膨胀方差以追踪非平稳。

exact_formulas.P: OLS slope k_b over normalized window time; P_b=k_b/(sum_j|k_j|+eps)
exact_formulas.posterior: Gaussian precision-weighted update; add delta^2 variance inflation; per-sample Thompson argmax

papers.verified_settings: W=16; cold-start50 training steps; not our four-inner optimizer counter
papers.code_status: No algorithm repository linked in inspected primary text; no implementation parity claim
papers.what_it_does_not_prove_zh: reward斜率仍是代理，不能识别单任务的边际因果贡献或排除跨任务迁移。优势大小也不是参数梯度方向。
papers.transfer_inference_zh: 最适合补目前只有单次rawA方差的缺口；优先用固定TRAIN probe进度做保守重加权，再单独比较Thompson控制器，避免同时换效用与采样器。

papers.title: When Does Closed-Loop Curriculum Adaptation Help GRPO? An Analysis on Countdown
papers.verified_method_zh: 固定greedy probe测各难度正确率；反馈分别控制前进速度与复习宽度，先前难度衰退时加宽覆盖，无反馈时回归参考课程。

exact_formulas.sampler: Gaussian over ordered buckets; separately bounded/EMA-smoothed pace beta and spread sigma

papers.verified_settings: 100 fixed probes per difficulty every100 optimizer steps; four training seeds with high dispersion, no significance claim
papers.code_status: Author-linked repository/readme accessible; full controller implementation not audited
papers.transfer_inference_zh: 适合借鉴独立的进度与遗忘反馈，驾驶场景没有天然operand难度序，不能照搬高斯难度轴。负进度只触发确认/覆盖诊断，不直接等于高学习价值。

papers.title: AceGRPO: Adaptive Curriculum Enhanced Group Relative Policy Optimization for Autonomous Machine Learning Engineering
papers.verified_method_zh: 把代码执行中间状态加入演化buffer；按reward离散程度与剩余空间组成potential，并用温度和最近采样抑制控制重复。
papers.code_status: Author-linked repository currently exposes README/.gitignore only; usable algorithm implementation not verified
papers.transfer_inference_zh: 比当前ACTIVE更接近同类启发式，仍不直接测实际进步。不能把其代码历史state转换，类推为把驾驶未来轨迹/metric-cache送入当前actor；保留当前观测合同。

papers.title: The Easy, the Hard, and the Learnable: Confidence and Difficulty-Adaptive Policy Optimization for LLM Reasoning
papers.verified_method_zh: 用rollout置信度与经验难度给问题赋有界价值，同时重加权更新并在mini-batch重采样。
papers.code_status: Official proceedings links repository; source implementation not audited for this review
papers.transfer_inference_zh: 当前连续动作transition维均值/clamp logp不是校准token置信度。不要直接拿exp(old_logp)做confidence；其梯度重加权与数据重采样应分别对照。

definitions.rawA_variance: Within-current-G dispersion of saved Safety credit before globalstd. Direction/opportunity proxy, not canonical utility or parameter-gradient norm.
definitions.learnability: Expected useful update potential; papers use proxies whose assumptions differ from our clamped per-step source PPO.
definitions.learning_progress: Change of a fixed population/metric under policy evolution; fixed-root ODE removes rollout root/noise resampling, not training randomness or cross-task transfer confounds.
definitions.forgetting: Drop from a predeclared previous/high reference on the same inference/scoring population. A negative slope is not automatically high expected benefit from rehearsal.
definitions.final_benefit: Matched-budget full deployment PDMS and gain/loss mass, zero repair/newzero and fixed-high retention; not priority activation, PG count or reward variance alone

current_immutable_implementation.implementation: Rank-local bounded bank, warmup8collections, first prioritycollection12, 3uniform+1priority; private RNG; rawAvar*(1+4p(1-p)) for mixed or rawAvar*(1-mean feasibleEP) for allfeasible headroom; cap3/cooldown8/TTL128.

interpretation_zh: 1k净少57个zero，但PDMS−.197299；固定control1k high队列平均−.932058，对总体贡献−.664396，零分修复贡献+.546141。少失败和多有效PG不能替代最终分。
该负结果只约束本实现/基座/预算与数据分布，不证明所有课程无效。CI为44物理log的已有名义区间，不包括训练seed变化或多路线/多时间选择修正。
当前rawA按Safety目标，不含全可行EP饱和时的Comfort差异；原high负A核实已有canonical排序反向实例，课程可能放大此方向差异。加progress权重不直接修复信用。
当前PG0主要成功饱和；canonical方差可由Comfort产生但SafetyA为零，不能把它当可学的安全失败。全fail cost-var仍可能有least-cost信用，但当前no-witness admission主动不优先它；uniform仍可到达。
noise_and_identifiability: 不同时间不同TRAIN batch/scene mix的平均reward斜率同时受场景组成、采样roots/innovation与theta变化影响，不能直接叫学习进度。
固定同token/同seed ODE面板可去掉重新抽rollout的噪声；数值、候选batch形状、scorer/cache仍须一致。它仍是in-sample TRAIN policy change，不是单次重放的因果边际收益。
两期点不足或每bucket样本/log太少时CI宽，保持中性权重；不得把回归均值、winner/max-of-history偏差或一两个token的跳变当遗忘事实。
跨sampler/currentθ的成功witness只证明观察到可行动作，不可伪装同theta当前deploy成功或用其SDE质量替代ODE progress。
不要求新多训练seed矩阵；单seed结论明确限定，利用paired物理log区间和独立TRAIN确认，所有查询与wallclock单列。

proposed_experiments.question: Does actual canonical TRAIN improvement help allocate the existing priority budget better than rawA variance alone?
proposed_experiments.comparator: Unchanged ACTIVE25 same freshIL70/seed42/G8/SafetyEP/W3/LR/reference; use a new separately bound source if approved, not current initial_v1 mutation
proposed_experiments.sole_change: Only category-level progress multiplier for weights inside the SAME existing eligible pool. 75%uniform floor/25%priority slot schedule/capacity256/maxrepeat3/cooldown8/TTL128 unchanged.
proposed_experiments.admission: Exactly existing variance>=1e-6 AND (mixed feasible OR allfeasible EP headroom). Allfail/no-witness and saturated rawA0 remain ineligible.
proposed_experiments.proposed_math: w_new(x)=w_current(x)*clip(1+p_bucket,.5,1.5); p_bucket=confirmed_signed_fixed_probe_slope/(sum|confirmed slopes|+eps). If CI crosses0/insufficient support/missing probe: p=0. No NAV input.
proposed_experiments.probe: OLS trend over last2-3 fixed probe epochs or first paired difference at500; use actual checkpoint updates not wall clock or changing training-batch means
proposed_experiments.falsifiable: If higher priority PG activity or repeated-scene improvement does not translate to independent TRAIN confirmation and matched full-PDMS/gain-loss benefit, reject this progress modifier under this recipe.
proposed_experiments.cannot_claim: Does NOT add forgotten saturated/allfail scenes to pool and cannot claim to solve forgetting. Cannot correct local credit misalignment or create missing candidate support.
proposed_experiments.retain_high: Measure fixed-high changes; no extra retention admission or teacher in this contrast
proposed_experiments.budget: Proposed1k/5k review only; no automatic10/50k, no launch now

proposed_experiments.question: Are genuinely regressed TRAIN observations omitted by original admission, and can a bounded extra rehearsal channel restore them?
proposed_experiments.comparator: Same unchanged ACTIVE25 without progress weighting initially, so admission/rehearsal is not bundled with unproven A
proposed_experiments.sole_change: Add a separately labeled verified-regression admission channel within existing total25%priority; cap rehearsal at half priority slots (12.5%overall), keep>=75%uniform and original stream cursor semantics.
proposed_experiments.admission: Current eligible OR a TRAIN scene with prior verified strict4>=.9 success and an actually observed fixed-root canonical/strict-quality regression. Save both CP/protocol/cache/inference identities. Cross-sampler or random-G8 changes alone are regression SUSPECT, not confirmed.
proposed_experiments.beyond_panel: Fixed panel triggers log/category alarm. A bounded rotating TRAIN-only audit outside panel confirms other current-run/compatible IL70-success observations before admission; do not infer every scene in that category has regressed.
proposed_experiments.rotating_budget: Optional64 TRAIN scenes/probe from same-category known-success bank or compatible IL70 TRAIN4096 cache, round-robin/log-balanced; audit cost separately. This is not authorized or run now.
proposed_experiments.nonzero_admission_weight: For confirmed-regression entries bypass rawA eligibility with a bounded positive rehearsal floor/quota; do not multiply by rawAvariance=0 and silently make the new channel dormant.
proposed_experiments.no_negativeLP_equals_value: Regression is a retention alarm, not measured usefulness. Do not rank by absolute negative slope. Keep maxrepeat3/cooldown/TTL and explicit confirmed/pending/unavailable status.
proposed_experiments.signal_gate: On actual fresh G8 rehearsal, report feasible/mixed/progress/costtie/PG0. Allfail costtie or successful-saturation A0 can remain anchor-only locally; resampling alone creates no guaranteed useful credit.
proposed_experiments.dependence: If new admission mostly yields PG0/no feasible witness, separately test an evidence-backed dense-failure or endpoint-exploration objective/sampler. Do not bundle it here or call rawprogress a safe teacher.
proposed_experiments.falsifiable: If verified-regression entries replay without new PG support/recovery or harm broader independent high cohort, reject rehearsal-only under this sampler/credit rather than declare negative LP valuable.
proposed_experiments.actor: Never feed historical future/cache/teacher into actor. Rehearsal means current observation re-collection; no CFM or old scored trajectory reuse in PG.
proposed_experiments.budget: Future bounded1k/5k only if root approves; endpoint8th arm currently takes priority, no data-arm launch

thompson_followup.key_guard: Nonstationary variance inflation, effective observation precision, private controller RNG and full native state required; paper50step/W16 defaults not copied as our4inner counters.
